priority_1_calibrated_ci.remediation: Apply 1.7x spread multiplier for VaR, or use 97a+qmap

priority_2_tail_behavior.assessment: Best-ever tail behavior. Perfect kurtosis match to GT.

priority_3_cross_cell_correlations.assessment: Near-perfect factor structure preservation. Best-ever correlation ratio.

priority_4_regime_sensitivity.assessment: S3 threshold unreachable on test split because GT itself is inverted (0.711). Base model passes (1.46). Test metric is invalid for this data period.
priority_4_regime_sensitivity.remediation: Validate on training data or use VIX-conditional spread metric

priority_5_long_horizon.assessment: Stable 252-day generation with no explosion, growing uncertainty, and preserved correlations.

sde_probe_tradeoff.description: SDE probe (154a) shows CI vs quality tradeoff
sde_probe_tradeoff.conclusion: No g achieves CI >= 0.80 AND KS >= 15/25 simultaneously. Fundamental tradeoff.

evidence.description: Test residuals 65% larger than training, indicating IV level distribution shifted

risk_manager_relevance.var_reporting: LOW — VaR depends on changes, not levels
risk_manager_relevance.scenario_planning: LOW — model conditions on current levels via encoder

needs_one_experiment.action: Full 9-suite eval at g=0.5-0.7 to quantify exact tradeoff
Validate conditionality on train/val split where GT turb/calm > 1.0
Run KS on rolling 2-year windows to confirm temporal shift

needs_fundamental_research.blocker: ODE contracts source randomness; SDE destroys distributional quality
Encoder carries level info not regime info (cosine 0.9996)

production_readiness.deployment_recommendation: Deploy for stress testing and hedging with documented CI limitation. Use 97a+qmap for VaR reporting. Apply 1.7x spread multiplier if 154c must be used for VaR.

comparison_vs_97a_qmap.summary: 97a+qmap wins on CI (via post-hoc calibration), 154c wins on distributional quality and long-horizon stability. Different models for different applications.

key_findings: 154c has the best distributional quality metrics ever achieved (kurtosis 1.003, corr_ratio 1.001)
CI gap (0.47 vs 0.80) is spread-dominated — ensemble is ~2x too narrow
Fundamental CI-vs-quality tradeoff: no SDE noise level achieves both CI >= 0.80 AND KS >= 15
KS levels failure (2/25) is train-test distribution shift, not model deficiency
S3 conditionality threshold is unreachable because GT test data is inverted (turb/calm = 0.711)
Long-horizon (252d) generation is stable with correct correlations and growing uncertainty
Model is production-ready for hedging, stress testing, and scenario generation
Model is NOT production-ready for VaR without spread adjustment
